content.comment_body: Hello, I have another issue with the [product_name] Web Editor. I'm unable to set decimal points in the Trend View component. When I select a variable and choose one decimal point, then save, nothing changes. Reopening the Trend View Variable shows the decimal places reset to zero. Other components in the web viewer handle decimal points for analog values correctly, but Trend View does not. Additionally, the analog output in [product_name] [document] is set to one decimal point. The same analog output works with the Rainbow component as expected.
You can set decimal places in Trend View only if the variable isn't defined in the tag table. This is a known bug in [product_name] V1.1.0.

Hi, I have PrivateTag selected in the table, not Variable1, 2, etc. When I choose any decimal point and save, it still shows 0 decimal points afterwards (see attached image). Is this a bug? Is there any workaround?
I came across an older post from [user_name], and apparently the table only displays 0, but the actual Trend View presents the decimal point.
Haha, sorry, I meant the post was old, not you.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have difficulty setting decimal points for analog values in the Trend View feature of the [product_name] Web Editor. Attempting to configure and save decimal places does not visually update in the table interface, though the correct decimal value is shown in the actual Trend View. Other visualization components, including Rainbow, work properly. Multiple contributors conclude this is a bug in specific software releases.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that configuring decimal precision for variables in Trend View should be stored, correctly displayed in the settings interface, and consistent with what appears in the visualization.
